Hi Sophie — thanks for the note.

Quick answers up front: we support DocuSign and Adobe Sign but DocuSign is our usual path; we can generate an envelope. We maintain a current subprocessor list and include it as an annex when executing DPAs. For EU-US transfers we support inserting the standard EU SCCs into the DPA, or we can provide our transfer addendum if that's preferred — open to whatever is simplest for your legal team.

I’ve attached our standard DPA template (Redwood_DPA_Template_20260712.docx) and a short dataflow summary. Can you confirm:
- Whether Novacorp requires a formal whitelist attestation for subprocessors or a published list updated quarterly
- If you need data residency guarantees (e.g., processing restricted to eu-west-1) or just regional controls

Looping in Ben (Privacy Ops) and Lauren (Legal Ops) to confirm internal routing and signing workflow. We aim to meet your July 26 POC timeline.

Next steps I propose:
1) You return your subprocessor list and any redlines to our DPA
2) We confirm transfer mechanism (SCCs vs Redwood addendum)
3) We prepare DocuSign envelope and route for signatures

Hi Camila — appreciate the fast reply. A few clarifications from our side:

- Signature: DocuSign is preferred by Legal and Procurement (we can accept Adobe in exceptional cases, but DocuSign is the default)
- Subprocessors: attached is our current subprocessors/impact matrix (novacorp_subprocessors_20260712.csv). We need Redwood to confirm whether those subprocessors will receive any customer data or just metadata/telemetry.
- Transfer mechanism: Novacorp prefers SCCs by default; if Redwood has a transfer addendum that maps to the SCCs we can review it, but please expect us to ask for SCC insertion unless the addendum explicitly references equivalent safeguards.
- Regions: We will request that processing for our account be restricted to eu-west-1 where possible; we understand some ephemeral tasks may be routed elsewhere for failover — please call that out in the DPA if needed.

Can you (or your Privacy Ops) provide a quick note on whether Redwood will accept SCCs added into the DPA or if you will insist on using your own transfer addendum? Also — please prepare a DocuSign envelope with the Redwood DPA and our intake form so we can begin routing on our side.

Thanks,
Sophie
